sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到侦探们最终查出了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: If you're interested in supporting the show, you can still find our subscriber channels on Patreon, Apple Podcasts, or Spotify.
sentences.zh: 如果你有兴趣支持本节目，仍然可以在 Patreon、Apple Podcasts 或 Spotify 上找到我们的订阅者专属频道。

sentences.en: However, please note that moving forward, we will no longer be producing premium-only episodes.
sentences.zh: 不过请注意，接下来我们将不再制作仅限高级会员的单集节目。

sentences.en: Paid subscribers will continue to receive new Casefile episodes one week early and ad-free,
sentences.zh: 付费订阅者将继续提前一周免费收听无广告的全新 Casefile 节目，

sentences.en: as well as episodes of Behind the Files, where the Casefile team answers your questions and discusses the recent cases we have covered.
sentences.zh: 以及《走近档案》（Behind the Files）节目，在其中 Casefile 团队将回答你的问题，并讨论我们最近报道过的案件。

sentences.en: As always, I'd like to offer a huge and heartfelt thank you to everyone who has listened and supported the show over the years, especially our Patreon and premium subscribers.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，我要向多年来一直收听并支持本节目的每一个人，尤其是我们的 Patreon 和高级订阅者，表达由衷的感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate each and every one of you.
sentences.zh: 我们感谢你们每一个人。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严重且通常令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果你在任何时候觉得需要支持，请联系你当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, and for a more detailed list of content warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码以及更详细的内容警告列表，请查看你手机应用上或我们网站上的本集节目注释。

sentences.en: It was nearing 3.30pm on Wednesday, January 6, 2016, when 27-year-old Jessica Wongso arrived at the Grand Indonesia Mall in central Jakarta.
sentences.zh: 2016年1月6日星期三下午3点30分左右，27岁的杰西卡·旺索抵达了雅加达市中心的印尼大商场。

sentences.en: She was due to meet two of her friends, Myrna Salihin and Hani Boone, for coffee at the upscale Olivier Café at 5pm.
sentences.zh: 她本应于下午5点在高档的奥利维尔咖啡馆与她的两个朋友米尔娜·萨利欣和哈尼·布恩见面喝咖啡。

sentences.en: It had been a while since the trio had all been together.
sentences.zh: 这三个人已经有一段时间没聚在一起了。

sentences.en: The three Indonesian women had met in Australia years prior while studying at the Billy Blue College of Design in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 这三位印尼女性几年前曾在澳大利亚悉尼的比利蓝设计学院求学时相识。

sentences.en: After graduating, Jessica had stayed in Australia while Myrna and Hani returned to Jakarta.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，杰西卡留在了澳大利亚，而米尔娜和哈尼则回到了雅加达。

sentences.en: They'd all remained in contact and caught up intermittently over the years, but this was Jessica's first trip back to Jakarta since 2012.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，她们一直保持联系并间断叙旧，但这是杰西卡自2012年以来首次返回雅加达。

sentences.en: Having arrived at the cafe early, Jessica went in to make a reservation.
sentences.zh: 由于提前到达咖啡馆，杰西卡便进去预订座位。

sentences.en: Olivier was a trendy venue that catered to high-end clientele.
sentences.zh: 奥利维尔是一家迎合高端客户的时尚场所。

sentences.en: It was known as a cool spot to be seen and was a favourite among Jakarta's more affluent crowds.
sentences.zh: 它被称为引人注目的酷炫打卡点，备受雅加达富裕阶层的青睐。

sentences.en: Customers could enjoy the eclectic menu of fine foods, desserts and cocktails while soaking in the natural light that poured in from the skylights above.
sentences.zh: 顾客们可以一边享受精美食物、甜点和鸡尾酒组成的丰富菜单，一边沐浴着从上方天窗倾泻而下的自然光。

sentences.en: An assortment of indoor plants perfectly complemented the green vinyl booths and timber finishes, creating an earthy yet sophisticated atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 各式各样的室内植物与绿色乙烯基卡座和木质装修完美相衬，营造出一种质朴而又精致的氛围。

sentences.en: It was the perfect spot for the friends, who came from well-off families and lived around the affluent Calapa Gardin district, to catch up.
sentences.zh: 对于出身富裕家庭且住在富人区卡拉帕加丁附近的朋友们来说，这里是叙旧的绝佳场所。

sentences.en: After reserving a table, Jessica still had plenty of time before her friends arrived.
sentences.zh: 订好桌子后，距离朋友们到来，杰西卡还有充足的时间。

sentences.en: She ventured back into the shopping mall and headed to Bath and Body Works, a fragrance and skincare store,
sentences.zh: 她再次走进购物中心，前往一家名为“身体与温存”的香水和护肤品商店，

sentences.en: where she bought a bottle of liquid soap for herself and each of her friends.
sentences.zh: 在那里她给自己和每个朋友都买了一瓶洗手液。

sentences.en: She then returned to Olivier with the soaps in three large paper gift bags.
sentences.zh: 随后，她带着装有肥皂的三个大纸质礼品袋回到了奥利维尔。

sentences.en: By this point, it was 4.14pm.
sentences.zh: 此时已经是下午4点14分。

sentences.en: Jessica took a seat at table 54, a large booth situated towards the back of the cafe.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡坐在54号桌，这是一张位于咖啡馆后部的宽敞卡座。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Jessica had messaged Myrna and Hany in their WhatsApp group, saying that she'd like to pay for their drinks that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，杰西卡在他们的 WhatsApp 群里给米尔娜和哈尼发消息，说她想请大家喝下午茶。

sentences.en: The others told her she didn't need to, but Jessica insisted.
sentences.zh: 其他人告诉她不用破费，但杰西卡坚持要请。

sentences.en: She walked over to the bar and ordered an old-fashioned cocktail for herself, a Sazerac for Hany, and a Vietnamese iced coffee for Myrna.
sentences.zh: 她走到吧台，为自己点了一杯老式鸡尾酒，为哈尼点了一杯萨泽拉克，并为米尔娜点了一杯越南冰咖啡。

sentences.en: Myrna was a self-proclaimed coffee snob, and she'd raved to the group about how much she loved Olivier's Vietnamese iced coffees.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜自称是个咖啡鉴赏家，她曾向群里大肆称赞自己有多喜欢奥利维尔的越南冰咖啡。

sentences.en: By the time Myrna and Hany finally arrived, it was 5.16pm.
sentences.zh: 等米尔娜和哈尼终于赶到时，已经是下午5点16分了。

sentences.en: Jessica stood up and warmly embraced her friends, letting them know she'd taken the liberty of ordering their drinks.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡站起身来，热情地拥抱了她的朋友们，并告诉她们她已经自作主张替她们点好了饮品。

sentences.en: Myrna thanked Jessica for this kind, albeit unnecessary gesture, and the three sat down and began chatting.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜对杰西卡这种贴心但其实没必要的举动表示感谢，随后三人坐下来开始聊天。

sentences.en: Myrna took a sip through the straw of her iced coffee.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜通过吸管喝了一口她的冰咖啡。

sentences.en: She immediately screwed her face up in disguSt.
sentences.zh: 她立刻恶心地皱起了眉头。

sentences.en: This tastes awful, she declared.
sentences.zh: 这味道太难喝了，她宣布道。

sentences.en: Myrna extended the drink towards Hany and asked her to taste it.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜把饮料递向哈尼，让她尝尝。

sentences.en: It didn't smell like coffee at all, and the colour didn't look quite right either.
sentences.zh: 这根本没有咖啡的香味，颜色看起来也不太对劲。

sentences.en: Hany reluctantly took a sip.
sentences.zh: 哈尼很不情愿地喝了一口。

sentences.en: It tasted bitter and burning.
sentences.zh: 尝起来又苦又辣。

sentences.en: Hany pushed the drink towards Jessica, but having seen her friends' reactions, Jessica refused to taste it.
sentences.zh: 哈尼把饮料推向杰西卡，但看到朋友们的反应后，杰西卡拒绝品尝。

sentences.en: Then, Myrna started fanning her face with her hand.
sentences.zh: 接着，米尔娜开始用手扇风。

sentences.en: Suddenly, she threw her head back and began convulsing.
sentences.zh: 突然，她把头向后仰去，开始抽搐。

sentences.en: The cafe staff saw what was going on and ran over to move the table out of the way and give Myrna some room.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆员工见状跑过来移开桌子，好给米尔娜腾出一些空间。

sentences.en: It was clear she was having trouble breathing and she soon began foaming at the mouth, her eyes rolling into the back of her head.
sentences.zh: 显然她呼吸困难，不久便口吐白沫，双眼上翻。

sentences.en: Olivier's manager joined the crowd that had gathered around trying to help.
sentences.zh: 奥利维尔的经理加入了围拢过来试图帮忙的人群。

sentences.en: Jessica Wongso stood next to her.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·旺索站在她身旁。

sentences.en: What did you put in the coffee?
sentences.zh: 你在咖啡里放了什么？

sentences.en: What did you put in the coffee?
sentences.zh: 你在咖啡里放了什么？

sentences.en: She asked.
sentences.zh: 她问道。

sentences.en: An unconscious Myrna Salehin was wheelchaired out of Olivier Cafe and to a medical centre within the shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 失去意识的米尔娜·萨利欣被用轮椅推出了奥利维尔咖啡馆，送到购物中心内的一个医疗中心。

sentences.en: Realising the seriousness of her condition, she was transported to hospital where doctors worked desperately to try and revive her.
sentences.zh: 意识到她病情严重，她被转送至医院，医生们全力抢救试图让她恢复心跳。

sentences.en: Her family immediately rushed to her side, having received a phone call from a hysterical Hany, who initially thought that Myrna might be having an epileptic seizure.
sentences.zh: 她的家人立刻赶到她身边，此前他们接到了一通情绪失控的哈尼打来的电话，哈尼最初以为米尔娜可能是癫痫发作。

sentences.en: Myrna's father, Eddie Salehin, despairingly tried to administer CPR to Myrna himself, while her twin sister Sandy yelled at her to wake up.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜的父亲埃迪·萨利欣绝望地亲自为米尔娜实施心肺复苏，而她的双胞胎姐姐珊迪则大喊着让她醒来。

sentences.en: But it was no use.
sentences.zh: 但无济于事。

sentences.en: Myrna was officially declared dead 30 minutes after arriving at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜在抵达医院30分钟后被正式宣布死亡。

sentences.en: The Salehin family was left in shock.
sentences.zh: 萨利欣一家陷入震惊之中。

sentences.en: As far as they were concerned, 27-year-old Myrna had been in perfect health.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，27岁的米尔娜一直非常健康。

sentences.en: She was in the prime of her life, working for a design company and having just gotten married to her adoring husband, Arif Samarko, two months earlier.
sentences.zh: 正值青春年华的她不仅在一家设计公司工作，而且就在两个月前刚刚嫁给了她深爱的丈夫阿里夫·萨马科。

sentences.en: They'd had an opulent ceremony at a luxury resort in Bali, attended by their closest friends and family.
sentences.zh: 他们曾在巴厘岛的一家豪华度假村举行了一场盛大的婚礼，至亲好友均出席见证。

sentences.en: Myrna had grand plans for her future, with the dreams of opening her own cafe and starting a family of her own.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜对未来有着宏伟的规划，梦想着开一家属于自己的咖啡馆并建立自己的家庭。

sentences.en: How, her family wondered, could she be taken from them so suddenly?
sentences.zh: 她的家人百思不得其解，她怎么会这么突然地离开他们？

sentences.en: Myrna's father, Eddie, reported his daughter's death to the police.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜的父亲埃迪向警方报告了女儿的死讯。

sentences.en: There was only one explanation he could think of for Myrna's sudden death, and it was that she had been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 对于米尔娜的突然离世，他能想到的唯一解释就是她遭到了谋杀下毒。

sentences.en: Harney Boone told the doctor that she had drank from Myrna's iced coffee and was worried that she would die too.
sentences.zh: 哈尼·布恩告诉医生，她喝了米尔娜的冰咖啡，担心自己也会死。

sentences.en: The doctor conducted a physical examination but concluded that Harney was fine.
sentences.zh: 医生进行了身体检查，但得出结论认为哈尼没事。

sentences.en: He prescribed a laxative and told her to eat and drink as much as possible to flush out any potential toxins from her system.
sentences.zh: 他开了一些泻药，并告诉她多吃多喝，以便排出体内的任何潜在毒素。

sentences.en: Jessica Wongso was also examined and given the all-clear,
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·旺索也接受了检查并确认一切正常，

sentences.en: while police took samples from Myrna's stomach contents for toxicological testing to determine if she had indeed been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方提取了米尔娜胃内容物的样本进行毒理学检测，以确定她是否真的被下毒。

sentences.en: The police went to Olivier Café and spoke to the staff there.
sentences.zh: 警方前往奥利维尔咖啡馆并与那里的员工交谈。

sentences.en: The barista who made the Vietnamese iced coffee, Runga Siputra, said there had been nothing unusual about the coffee.
sentences.zh: 制作越南冰咖啡的咖啡师伦加·西普特拉表示，这杯咖啡没有什么不寻常的地方。

sentences.en: After the receipt for the order came through, Runga said he made the beverage like he always did, filling a glass with ice and a couple of spoons of condensed milk,
sentences.zh: 在收到订单小票后，伦加说他像往常一样制作饮品，在玻璃杯里装满冰块并加入几勺炼乳，

sentences.en: before placing what's known as a fiend filter full of ground coffee on top of it and pouring over hot water.
sentences.zh: 然后在上面放置一个装满咖啡粉的所谓法兰绒滤网，并倒入热水。

sentences.en: He then put the coffee on a tray to be taken out by the server.
sentences.zh: 随后他把咖啡放在托盘上，由服务员端出去。

sentences.en: The server didn't find anything unusual about the coffee when he took it over to table 54.
sentences.zh: 服务员将咖啡端到54号桌时，并没有发现它有什么异常。

sentences.en: It looked and smelt like it always did.
sentences.zh: 它的外观和气味都和平时一样。

sentences.en: After Myrna collapsed, Olivier's bar manager, Divi Siagian, took the iced coffee into the back kitchen and examined it herself.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜晕倒后，奥利维尔的酒吧经理迪维·西亚吉安将这杯冰咖啡拿进后厨并亲自进行了检查。

sentences.en: She had immediate concerns about it based on Jessica Wongso's comment about what had been put into it.
sentences.zh: 根据杰西卡·旺索关于咖啡里被放了东西的言论，她对此产生了直接的担忧。

sentences.en: Divi gave the iced coffee a whiff and took a sip.
sentences.zh: 迪维闻了闻这杯冰咖啡，并尝了一小口。

sentences.en: It smelt and tasted rotten.
sentences.zh: 它闻起来和尝起来都变质了。

sentences.en: Runga, the barista who made the iced coffee, came in and noticed that the colour had changed since he made it.
sentences.zh: 制作冰咖啡的咖啡师伦加走了进来，并注意到它的颜色自制作以来已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: It should have been brown, but it had turned the golden yellow colour of turmeric.
sentences.zh: 它本应该是棕色的，但却变成了姜黄色的金黄色。

sentences.en: Runga sniffed the coffee and was hit with a sharp odour that smelt like glue.
sentences.zh: 伦加闻了闻咖啡，迎面扑来一股刺鼻的胶水味。

sentences.en: It instantly irritated his nose.
sentences.zh: 这立刻刺激了他的鼻子。

sentences.en: Panicked, Runga began double-checking all of the ingredients he'd used to make the drink, but everything appeared to be completely fine.
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措的伦加开始仔细核对制作该饮品所使用的所有原料，但一切看起来都完全正常。

sentences.en: Having kept the drink aside, a bartender poured the leftover iced coffee into an empty water bottle and handed it over to the police for toxicological testing.
sentences.zh: 在将这杯饮品留存下来后，一名调酒师将剩下的冰咖啡倒入一个空水瓶中，并交给了警方进行毒理学检测。

sentences.en: Three days after Myrna Salihin's death, the results came back.
sentences.zh: 在米尔娜·萨利欣去世三天后，检测结果出来了。

sentences.en: It was confirmed that the iced coffee contained cyanide, a rapidly acting and highly lethal poison.
sentences.zh: 经证实，这杯冰咖啡中含有氰化物，这是一种起效极快且剧毒无比的毒药。

sentences.en: When ingested, cyanide affects the cardiovascular and central nervous system by preventing the body's cells from receiving or absorbing oxygen.
sentences.zh: 当摄入氰化物时，它会阻止人体细胞接收或吸收氧气，从而影响心血管和中枢神经系统。

sentences.en: Within minutes of absorbing the poison, a person can experience organ failure, convulsions, coma and death.
sentences.zh: 在吸收毒药后的几分钟内，人就会出现器官衰竭、抽搐、昏迷甚至死亡。

sentences.en: While all of this was consistent with the symptoms Myrna exhibited right before her death, a full autopsy would need to be done to prove that she hadn't died from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 虽然这一切都符合米尔娜死前表现出的症状，但仍需进行全面尸检以证明她并非死于自然原因。

sentences.en: The police met with Myrna's family at the funeral home and requested permission to perform a full autopsy.
sentences.zh: 警方在殡仪馆会见了米尔娜的家人，并请求准许进行全面尸检。

sentences.en: Her mother refused, saying she didn't want anyone to touch her daughter's body.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲拒绝了，称她不想让任何人触碰女儿的遗体。

sentences.en: They intended to have an open casket funeral for Myrna the following day, and her body had already been prepared for burial.
sentences.zh: 他们打算第二天为米尔娜举行开棺瞻仰遗容的葬礼，而且她的遗体已经为下葬做好了准备。

sentences.en: This was a major roadblock for the police.
sentences.zh: 这对警方来说是一个重大的阻碍。

sentences.en: They explained that without an autopsy being done, they wouldn't be able to conduct a proper investigation to prove that Myrna had actually been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，如果不进行尸检，他们将无法开展彻底的调查来证明米尔娜确实是被毒死的。

sentences.en: After some deliberation, Myrna's family continued to reject the full autopsy, but they agreed that her stomach and liver could be removed for further toxicological testing.
sentences.zh: 经过一番商议，米尔娜的家人仍然拒绝全面尸检，但他们同意取出她的胃和肝脏进行进一步的毒理学检测。

sentences.en: Myrna's funeral went ahead the following day.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜的葬礼于次日如期举行。

sentences.en: Myrna was a popular and deeply loved young woman, and it was a highly emotional time for those in attendance.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜是一位广受欢迎且深受深爱的年轻女性，对出席的人来说，这是一个充满悲伤情绪的时刻。

sentences.en: For Myrna's father, Eddie Salihin, the loss of his daughter made him feel like he'd lost his sparring partner.
sentences.zh: 对米尔娜的父亲埃迪·萨利欣而言，失去女儿让他觉得自己仿佛失去了人生中势均力敌的伴侣。

sentences.en: Eddie was a successful, wealthy businessman with a tough, no-nonsense attitude.
sentences.zh: 埃迪是一位成功且富有的商人，有着强硬、雷厉风行的态度。

sentences.en: He'd always seen traits in Myrna that he recognised in himself, and he admired the way she challenged him whenever they had a disagreement.
sentences.zh: 他在米尔娜身上总是能看到自己的影子，并对她每逢意见不合时敢于向自己挑战的方式赞赏有加。

sentences.en: Following his daughter's burial, Eddie told reporters,
sentences.zh: 在女儿下葬后，埃迪告诉记者，

sentences.en: There was one person who was noticeably absent from Myrna's burial, and that was Jessica Wongso.
sentences.zh: 有一个人明显缺席了米尔娜的葬礼，那就是杰西卡·旺索。

sentences.en: Some wondered why she wasn't there, given the two seemed to be close friends and had been together when Myrna died.
sentences.zh: 鉴于两人似乎是密友，且在米尔娜死时陪伴在侧，一些人感到疑惑她为什么没有出席。

sentences.en: But the truth was that Jessica wouldn't have been very welcome there.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，杰西卡其实并不太受欢迎。

sentences.en: Myrna's parents had always viewed Jessica as a bit peculiar.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜的父母一直觉得杰西卡有点古怪。

sentences.en: The first time they'd met her, she'd been overly affectionate in the way she hugged Myrna's mother.
sentences.zh: 他们第一次见到她时，她在拥抱米尔娜的母亲时显得过分热情。

sentences.en: When she first visited their house, they also found it strange that she had entered their bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当她第一次到他们家做客时，他们也觉得她竟然进入他们的卧室很不寻常。

sentences.en: Her odd behaviour continued at the hospital on the day Myrna died.
sentences.zh: 她在米尔娜去世当天在医院里的怪异行为仍在继续。

sentences.en: Unlike Harney, who had been in a clear state of shock and distress, Jessica had been oddly calm.
sentences.zh: 与明显处于震惊和痛苦之中的哈尼不同，杰西卡出奇地冷静。

sentences.en: Eddie's Sally Hinn felt like Jessica was avoiding him by pretending to be short of breath and have a stomach ache.
sentences.zh: 埃迪·萨利欣觉得杰西卡通过假装气短和胃痛来躲避他。

sentences.en: He asked Jessica what she had to drink at the cafe, and she told him mineral water.
sentences.zh: 他问杰西卡在咖啡馆喝了什么，她告诉他是矿泉水。

sentences.en: Eddie was surprised by this response.
sentences.zh: 埃迪对这个回答感到惊讶。

sentences.en: He'd seen the receipt from Olivier and knew that Jessica had ordered cocktails for herself and Harney.
sentences.zh: 他看过奥利维尔的小票，知道杰西卡给自己和哈尼点的是鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: He couldn't understand why she would lie about such a thing, unless, of course, she had something to hide.
sentences.zh: 他不明白她为什么要为这种事撒谎，除非，当然，她有什么不可告人的秘密。

sentences.en: The day after Myrna's burial, toxicology tests confirmed the presence of cyanide in her stomach.
sentences.zh: 在米尔娜下葬后的第二天，毒理学检测证实她的胃中含有氰化物。

sentences.en: With the police now confident that she had definitely been poisoned, they reviewed the footage taken from the nine CCTV cameras around Olivier Café on Wednesday, January 6.
sentences.zh: 随着警方现在确信她绝对是被毒死的，他们调取了1月6日星期三奥利维尔咖啡馆周围9个闭路电视摄像头的监控录像。

sentences.en: There didn't appear to be anything unusual about Runga Siputra's actions as he made the Vietnamese iced coffee,
sentences.zh: 伦加·西普特拉在制作越南冰咖啡时的行为看起来没有什么不寻常之处，

sentences.en: nor did the server interfere with the drink in any way when bringing it over to Jessica's table at 4.24pm.
sentences.zh: 服务员在下午4点24分将饮品端到杰西卡桌子上的过程中也没有对饮品做任何手脚。

sentences.en: It sat there out in the open for 52 minutes until Myrna and Harney arrived at 5.16pm.
sentences.zh: 它就那样大剌剌地摆在那里长达52分钟，直到下午5点16分米尔娜和哈尼到达。

sentences.en: At no point between the drink being delivered and Myrna taking the first sip did anyone else approach the table.
sentences.zh: 在饮品送达和米尔娜喝第一口之间的任何时间里，都没有其他人走近过这张桌子。

sentences.en: Jessica Wongso was filmed arriving at the cafe lobby at 3.30pm.
sentences.zh: 监控拍到杰西卡于下午3点30分抵达咖啡馆大厅。

sentences.en: She then made her way into the main dining area to choose a table for her group.
sentences.zh: 然后她走进主用餐区，为她们这一组人挑选桌子。

sentences.en: But there was something odd about her movements that seemed unnatural.
sentences.zh: 但她的某些举止看起来有些诡异且不自然。

sentences.en: She walked around the room in a somewhat suspicious manner, looking around as though she was scoping the place out.
sentences.zh: 她在房间里以一种多少有些可疑的方式四处走动，东张西望，仿佛在踩点。

sentences.en: At one point, she looked directly at one of the security cameras.
sentences.zh: 有那么一会儿，她直直地看着其中一个安全摄像头。

sentences.en: The table Jessica eventually chose, table number 54, was located towards the back of the cafe, where the closest camera was obscured by a large pot filled with indoor plants.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡最终挑选的桌子，即54号桌，位于咖啡馆后部，最近的摄像头被一个摆满室内植物的大花盆遮挡了。

sentences.en: However, another camera at the opposite side of the restaurant provided a direct, albeit grainy, view.
sentences.zh: 不过，餐厅另一侧的另一个摄像头提供了一个直接但有些模糊的视角。

sentences.en: This camera captured Jessica as she sat down in the booth and placed the three gift bags from Bath and Body Works on top of the table, arranging them in a line.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头拍下了杰西卡坐在卡座上，把来自“身体与温存”的三个礼品袋放在桌子上，并将它们排成一排的过程。

sentences.en: When the waiter placed a menu plate at the end of the table, Jessica picked it up and placed it parallel to the gift bags.
sentences.zh: 当服务员在桌子尽头放好菜单盘时，杰西卡把它拿起来，摆放得与礼品袋平行。

sentences.en: Once the drinks arrived, the bags essentially acted as a barrier, obstructing the drinks from the view of the camera on the other side of the room.
sentences.zh: 一旦饮品送达，这些袋子基本上就成了一道屏障，挡住了房间另一侧摄像头对饮品的视线。

sentences.en: Police couldn't see exactly what Jessica was doing behind the gift bags, but at one stage she made some movements as though she was taking something out of her handbag.
sentences.zh: 警方无法看清杰西卡在礼品袋后面具体在做什么，但在某个阶段她做了一些动作，就像是从手提包里掏出什么东西一样。

sentences.en: She later moved the iced coffee cup around, placing it further down the table to where Myrna would eventually sit.
sentences.zh: 她随后挪动了冰咖啡杯，把它放得更靠近桌子下方，也就是后来米尔娜坐的地方。

sentences.en: Minutes before Myrna and Harney arrived, she put the gift bags on the floor.
sentences.zh: 在米尔娜和哈尼到达前几分钟，她把礼品袋放到了地板上。

sentences.en: Once Myrna took a sip of the iced coffee, she began exhibiting symptoms almost immediately, waving her hands in front of her face as though trying to cool herself down.
sentences.zh: 米尔娜喝了一口冰咖啡后，几乎立刻开始出现症状，双手在脸前挥舞，仿佛想让自己凉快点。

sentences.en: After she collapsed and the staff rushed over to help, a panic-stricken Harney called Myrna's husband Arif on her mobile to let him know what was happening
sentences.zh: 在她晕倒、员工赶来帮忙后，惊慌失措的哈尼用手机拨打了米尔娜丈夫阿里夫的电话，告诉他正在发生的事情，

sentences.en: and to ask if Myrna had any pre-existing health conditions that could explain what was going on.
sentences.zh: 并询问米尔娜是否有任何既往病史可以解释眼前发生的一切。

sentences.en: While all of this was happening, Jessica stood back from the crowd, watching on with little emotion while rubbing her hands together.
sentences.zh: 正当这一切发生时，杰西卡退居人群之后，一边搓着双手一边冷眼旁观。

sentences.en: This was a significant moment for the police.
sentences.zh: 这对警方来说是一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: When cyanide comes into contact with the skin, it causes irritation, itching, and a dermatological condition known as cyanide rash.
sentences.zh: 当氰化物接触皮肤时，会导致刺激、瘙痒以及被称为氰化物皮炎的皮肤病状况。

sentences.en: Based on the footage, they began to theorise that Jessica had invited Myrna out for a drink with the intention of poisoning her.
sentences.zh: 根据监控录像，他们开始推测杰西卡邀请米尔娜出来喝酒就是怀着将其毒害的目的。

sentences.en: Beyond the cafe staff, there was simply no other person who had the opportunity to tamper with Myrna's drink.
sentences.zh: 除了咖啡厅的工作人员，根本没有其他人有机会在美娜的饮料中下毒。

sentences.en: It also explained why Jessica had arrived so much earlier than her friends and why she'd offered to buy their drinks in advance.
sentences.zh: 这也解释了为什么杰西卡比她的朋友们早到那么多，以及她为什么会主动提出帮他们提前买好饮品。

sentences.en: Furthermore, after Myrna died, Jessica had sent Myrna's twin sister Sandy a message asking if her family had received the results of Myrna's lab tests yet.
sentences.zh: 此外，在美娜死后，杰西卡曾给美娜的双胞胎姐姐桑迪发了一条消息，询问她的家人是否已经收到美娜的化验结果。

sentences.en: She also sent Sandy a link to a news story about fake coffee containing cyanide that was being sold in Vietnam and suggested that's what could have happened to Myrna.
sentences.zh: 她还给桑迪发了一条关于越南出售含氰化物假咖啡的新闻报道链接，并暗示美娜可能也遭遇了这种事。

sentences.en: From the way Jessica had surveyed the restaurant, the police believed she'd arrived early so she could scope out the locations of the security cameras
sentences.zh: 从杰西卡观察餐厅的方式来看，警方认为她早到是为了观察监控摄像头的位置，

sentences.en: and choose a table that was out of their view.
sentences.zh: 并挑选一张避开监控视角的桌子。

sentences.en: She then purchased the items from Bath and Body Works so the gift bags would provide an added layer of protection while she stealthily slipped the cyanide into Myrna's iced coffee,
sentences.zh: 接着，她在 Bath and Body Works 买了一些东西，这样礼品袋就能在暗中将氰化物滑入美娜的冰咖啡时提供一层额外的掩护，

sentences.en: getting some on her hands in the process.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中她的手上还沾到了一些。

sentences.en: A review of the WhatsApp messages sent between the friend group revealed that Jessica had asked if there was a medical clinic inside the shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 对朋友圈中发送的 WhatsApp 消息的审查显示，杰西卡曾打听购物中心内是否有医疗诊所。

sentences.en: She claimed she needed to get a prescription for vitamin D, but investigators suspected there could be a more sinister reason for her query.
sentences.zh: 她声称自己需要开维生素D的处方，但调查人员怀疑她打听背后有更险恶的动机。

sentences.en: What if she was checking to make sure there wouldn't be a doctor on site who could administer first aid to Myrna and potentially save her life?
sentences.zh: 万一她是想确认现场没有能够对美娜实施急救并可能挽救她生命的医生呢？

sentences.en: The problem was, the cameras hadn't actually captured Jessica putting anything into Myrna's drink and no traces of cyanide had been found at their table.
sentences.zh: 问题是，监控摄像头实际上并没有拍到杰西卡往美娜的饮料里放任何东西，而且在他们的桌上也没有发现任何氰化物的痕迹。

sentences.en: Jessica had been summoned to the police station for an interview after the toxicology tests came back and she'd appeared calm the whole time,
sentences.zh: 毒理学检测结果出来后，杰西卡被传唤到警察局接受问询，她全程表现得很平静，

sentences.en: saying nothing that incriminated her in Myrna's murder.
sentences.zh: 没有说任何会让自己卷入美娜谋杀案的话。

sentences.en: She had no criminal record in Indonesia and told the police she'd never had any trouble with the law.
sentences.zh: 她在印度尼西亚没有犯罪记录，并告诉警方她从来没有惹上过任何法律麻烦。

sentences.en: A search of her parents' home in Jakarta didn't turn up any evidence of cyanide nor was there any trace of the poison found in Jessica's handbag.
sentences.zh: 对她父母在雅加达的家的搜查没有发现任何氰化物的证据，在杰西卡的手提包里也没有找到这种毒药的踪迹。

sentences.en: However, when police asked Jessica for the clothing she had been wearing on the day Myrna died, she told them she had thrown the pants away.
sentences.zh: 然而，当警方要求杰西卡交出美娜死那天她穿的衣服时，她告诉他们她把裤子扔了。

sentences.en: She said they'd gotten a hole in them on the way to the hospital and had asked her maid to get rid of them.
sentences.zh: 她说裤子在去医院的路上破了个洞，并让女佣把它们扔掉了。

sentences.en: Police seized a computer, documents and tissues from Jessica's house, but found nothing that tied her to the poisoning.
sentences.zh: 警方从杰西卡家中查获了一台电脑、文件和纸巾，但没有发现任何将她与这起投毒案联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: Then there was the obvious question of what motive Jessica could possibly have to want Myrna dead.
sentences.zh: 接下来还有一个显而易见的问题：杰西卡到底有什么动机想要置美娜于死地？

sentences.en: Not only did she claim they were good friends, but an examination of text messages sent between the two showed nothing but a typical female friendship
sentences.zh: 她不仅声称两人是好朋友，而且对两人之间发送的短信的检查也只显示出典型的女性友谊，

sentences.en: and no one in their social circle knew of any overt friction between them.
sentences.zh: 她们社交圈里的任何人也不知道她们之间有什么公开的摩擦。

sentences.en: They also didn't think of Jessica as a violent or dangerous person.
sentences.zh: 他们也不认为杰西卡是一个暴力或危险的人。

sentences.en: Most knew her to be bubbly and a bit goofy, not the kind to commit such a callous crime.
sentences.zh: 大多数人了解的她是个活泼开朗、有点滑稽的人，并不是那种会犯下如此冷酷罪行的人。

sentences.en: Police spoke to Myrna's husband, Arif Samarko, to see what he knew about Jessica and Myrna's relationship.
sentences.zh: 警方与美娜的丈夫阿里夫·萨马科进行了交谈，以了解他所知道的杰西卡和美娜的关系。

sentences.en: The only thing Arif could think of was a minor incident that Myrna had told him about back in October 2014, roughly 14 months before she died.
sentences.zh: 阿里夫能想到的只有美娜在 2014 年 10 月左右（即她去世前大约 14 个月）向他提起过的一件小事。

sentences.en: Having returned to Sydney for a holiday,
sentences.zh: 当时美娜回到悉尼度假，

sentences.en: Myrna had caught up with Jessica for a coffee.
sentences.zh: 和杰西卡见面喝了杯咖啡。

sentences.en: As they chatted, Jessica told Myrna about some problems she was having with her boyfriend at the time, a man named Patrick O'Connor.
sentences.zh: 在他们聊天时，杰西卡向美娜倾诉了她当时与男友帕特里克·奥康纳相处时遇到的一些问题。

sentences.en: She apparently said that Patrick could be rough with her and that he had some problems with the drugs.
sentences.zh: 她显然说过帕特里克对她很粗暴，而且他在毒品方面有些问题。

sentences.en: Myrna had never met Patrick, but she didn't like the sound of him and couldn't fathom what Jessica saw in him.
sentences.zh: 美娜从未见过帕特里克，但她觉得这个人听起来不像好人，也无法理解杰西卡到底看上了他哪一点。

sentences.en: According to Arif, Myrna could be very upfront about her opinions and she told Jessica not to be stupid.
sentences.zh: 据阿里夫说，美娜在表达观点时非常直率，她告诉杰西卡不要犯傻。

sentences.en: She told Jessica to think about her future and urged her to end the relationship.
sentences.zh: 她让杰西卡考虑一下自己的未来，并敦促她结束这段关系。

sentences.en: Jessica didn't like what she heard and had reportedly stormed out of the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡不喜欢听到这些，据报道当时气冲冲地跑出了餐厅。

sentences.en: Arif said that Myrna became wary of Jessica after that and no longer wanted to meet up with her one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 阿里夫说，从那以后美娜对杰西卡产生了戒备心，不再愿意单独和她见面。

sentences.en: When Jessica returned to Jakarta in December 2015, one month before Myrna died,
sentences.zh: 当杰西卡于 2015 年 12 月（即美娜去世前一个月）返回雅加达时，

sentences.en: Arif joined Myrna when the two women had first caught up for coffee.
sentences.zh: 这两个女人初次见面喝咖啡时，阿里夫也加入了。

sentences.en: He and Myrna had only recently tied the knot in Bali and they were still riding the wave of newlywed bliss.
sentences.zh: 他和美娜刚在巴厘岛结为夫妻，他们仍然沉浸在新婚的幸福喜悦之中。

sentences.en: Jessica hadn't been invited to the wedding, but if she held any grudges about this, she made no mention of it.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡没有受到婚礼的邀请，但如果她对此有什么怨恨的话，她一句也没提。

sentences.en: While these minor incidents indicated that things weren't completely rosy between the two friends, it still didn't suggest why Jessica Wongso would want Myrna Sali-Hin dead
sentences.zh: 虽然这些小摩擦表明这两个朋友之间的关系并非完全一帆风顺，但它仍然无法解释为什么杰西卡·旺索会想要美娜·萨利欣死，

sentences.en: or how she'd managed to pull off such an elaborate plot.
sentences.zh: 也不知道她是如何设法实施如此精心策划的阴谋的。

sentences.en: For the average citizen, cyanide isn't exactly easy to come by.
sentences.zh: 对于普通公民来说，氰化物并不是那么容易弄到的。

sentences.en: Although it's a naturally occurring chemical found in many plants, such as apple seeds, almonds and tapioca, the level of cyanide found in the foods we consume is very low.
sentences.zh: 虽然它是一种存在于许多植物（如苹果籽、杏仁和木薯）中的天然化学物质，但我们食用的食物中发现的氰化物水平非常低。

sentences.en: It's the man-made version, available in gas, liquid and solid form that's fast-acting and highly lethal.
sentences.zh: 人造版本的氰化物有气体、液体和固体形式，见效快且剧毒。

sentences.en: Cyanide is illegal in Indonesia and police could find no evidence of Jessica having sourced or attempting to source it from anywhere.
sentences.zh: 氰化物在印度尼西亚是非法的，警方没有找到任何证据表明杰西卡曾从任何地方获取或试图获取它。

sentences.en: However, that didn't mean it wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不意味着这是不可能的。

sentences.en: In Indonesia, it was once a common practice to catch fish using cyanide.
sentences.zh: 在印度尼西亚，过去有一种用氰化物捕鱼的常见做法。

sentences.en: Fishermen would add a small amount of the chemical to waterways to stun fish and send them floating to the surface.
sentences.zh: 渔民会在水道中加入少量的化学物质来电晕鱼，使它们浮到水面上。

sentences.en: Although this practice had become illegal, the laws were minimally enforced and it wasn't difficult to buy cyanide from illegal sellers.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种做法已经变成非法的，但法律的执行力度很小，从非法卖家那里买到氰化物并不难。

sentences.en: If Jessica had managed to source the cyanide, police considered how she could have gotten the cyanide into the iced coffee.
sentences.zh: 如果杰西卡设法弄到了氰化物，警方会考虑她是如何将氰化物弄进冰咖啡里的。

sentences.en: According to Olivier's staff, it was café policy that all straws must be served alongside drinks with a paper sheath at the top for hygiene purposes.
sentences.zh: 据奥利弗餐厅的工作人员称，餐厅的规定是，所有饮料端上时，吸管顶部必须带有纸套，以保证卫生。

sentences.en: Yet, some staff members recalled that the sheath had been removed from Myrna's straw and placed into her iced coffee before she arrived.

sentences.en: Not only was this incredibly low dose not enough to be fatal, but no cyanide was detected in her bowel or liver, which would be expected in a case of cyanide poisoning.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚实行大陆法系。

sentences.zh: 在刑事审判中没有陪审团。

sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，一队公共检察官与辩护团队针锋相对，而一个由三名法官组成的合议庭则决定被告的命运。

sentences.en: Jessica's defence team spoke to at least two forensic pathologists who explained that the low levels of cyanide detected in Mina's stomach could have been produced post-mortem,

sentences.zh: 他们坐在法庭正前方，而证人独自坐在法庭中央的椅子上，两边的辩护和控方团队则各居一侧。

sentences.en: During opening arguments, the prosecution team presented their theory that a jealous
sentences.zh: 在开庭陈述中，控方团队提出了他们的推论：

sentences.en: Jessica Wongso had been motivated to kill Mina Salihin to avenge the pain she felt over her breakup with Patrick O'Connor.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·旺索（Jessica Wongso）因对帕特里克·奥康纳（Patrick O'Connor）提出分手感到痛苦，为报复这一心碎，她产生了杀害薇娜·萨利欣（Mina Salihin）的动机。

sentences.en: They believed Jessica had arrived at Olivier Café armed with the cyanide, and intentionally chose a table out of view of the security cameras,
sentences.zh: 他们认为，杰西卡带着氰化物来到奥利弗咖啡馆（Olivier Café），并故意选择了一个监控摄像头拍不到的座位，

sentences.en: where she used the three gift bags to further shield what she was about to do.
sentences.zh: 在那里她利用三个礼品袋进一步遮挡她即将实施的行为。

sentences.en: Ordering the drinks before her friend's arrival, she administered the cyanide behind the bags, and then watched on with barely feigned concern as the poison took its toll on Mina.
sentences.zh: 在朋友到来之前点好饮品后，她在袋子后面下了氰化物，随后在毒药对薇娜起效时，带着几乎毫不掩饰的担忧在一旁观望。

sentences.en: The defence team argued there was no evidence to prove any such claiMs.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队则辩称，没有任何证据可以证明这些指控。

sentences.en: One of her lawyers stated, It does not make sense that Jessica flew all the way from Australia to Indonesia to murder Mina.
sentences.zh: 她的一位律师表示：“杰西卡大老远从澳大利亚飞到印度尼西亚谋杀薇娜，这根本说不通。”

sentences.en: It also does not make sense that Jessica would murder Mina because she had once asked Jessica to end her relationship with her boyfriend at the time.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡会因为薇娜曾要求她与当时的男友分手而谋杀薇娜，这也说不通。

sentences.en: Turning to the judges, he asked,
sentences.zh: 他转向法官问道：

sentences.en: Why is Jessica the only one suspected of murder when she did not do anything unusual, and nobody witnessed her putting cyanide into the coffee?
sentences.zh: “既然杰西卡没有做任何异常举动，也没有人目击她将氰化物放入咖啡中，为什么她会成为唯一的谋杀嫌疑人？”

sentences.en: The defence said the possibility that someone else was responsible for the poisoning couldn't be discounted.
sentences.zh: 辩方表示，不能排除是其他人导致了这起中毒事件的可能性。

sentences.en: A bartender from Olivier Café testified to having poured Mina's iced coffee into an empty water bottle and handing it over to the police for testing.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗咖啡馆的一名调酒师作证称，他曾将薇娜的冰咖啡倒入一个空水瓶中，并交给了警方进行检测。

sentences.en: While some staff members recalled that the glass had then been secured in cling wrap and handed to the police too, the bartender testified
sentences.zh: 虽然一些员工回忆说，那个玻璃杯随后被保鲜膜封好也交给了警方，但调酒师作证说

sentences.en: that he had returned the empty glass to the cafe pantry.
sentences.zh: 他已经把空杯子放回了咖啡馆的储藏室。

sentences.en: Oto Hazibwan pointed out that the police brief of evidence said that cyanide was found in the water bottle as well as the coffee glass.
sentences.zh: 奥托·哈齐万（Oto Hazibwan）指出，警方证据摘要中称，在水瓶和咖啡杯中都发现了氰化物。

sentences.en: If the bartender's testimony was correct, then what glass had police used for testing?
sentences.zh: 如果调酒师的证词属实，那么警方究竟是用哪个杯子进行检测的？

sentences.en: The police had also asked Olivier's manager to provide them with a glass of Vietnamese iced coffee
sentences.zh: 警方还曾要求奥利弗的经理提供一杯越南冰咖啡，

sentences.en: they could compare to Mina's drink, as well as another empty water bottle that they could pour the comparison beverage into.
sentences.zh: 以便与薇娜的饮品进行对比，并提供另一个空水瓶，好把对比饮品倒进去。

sentences.en: Therefore, if the bartender had misremembered, the police should have had two glasses and two bottles.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果调酒师记错了，警方本该有两个杯子和两个瓶子。

sentences.en: Yet, their brief of evidence inexplicably mentioned just one bottle and two glasses.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们的证据摘要却莫名其妙地只提到一个瓶子和两个杯子。

sentences.en: Given these inconsistencies and the fact that no one else who tasted the drink became severely ill, the defence said it couldn't be ruled out that either the cafe
sentences.zh: 鉴于这些矛盾之处，且其他品尝过该饮品的人都没有出现严重不适，辩方表示，不能排除咖啡馆

sentences.en: staff or the police could have added the cyanide to the iced coffee after Mina drank it, but before it was tested.
sentences.zh: 员工或警方可能在薇娜喝下冰咖啡之后、检测之前将其加入了饮品中。

sentences.en: This wasn't an outlandish allegation to make.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一个荒谬的指控。

sentences.en: The Indonesian legal system is notoriously corrupt, with the judges and prosecutors known to take bribes from people in positions of power.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，印尼的法律体系严重腐败，法官和检察官收受权势人物贿赂的现象屡见不鲜。

sentences.en: Rumours had circulated that Mina's father could have worked with the police to secure a conviction against
sentences.zh: 曾有传言称，薇娜的父亲可能与警方勾结，不惜一切代价也要将

sentences.en: Jessica at any cost necessary.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡定罪。

sentences.en: Although there was absolutely no evidence to support such an allegation, talk of corruption had surrounded the case from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 尽管绝对没有证据支持这种指控，但有关腐败的传言从案件一开始就环绕不去。

sentences.en: The defence also pointed out that Olivier's barista, Runga Saputra, had disposed of the hot water from the kettle that had been used to make Mina's iced coffee.
sentences.zh: 辩方还指出，奥利弗的咖啡师伦加·萨普特拉（Runga Saputra）处理掉了用来冲泡薇娜冰咖啡的水壶中的热水。

sentences.en: They suggested this could have been a deliberate move to ensure the water couldn't be tested for cyanide.
sentences.zh: 他们暗示，这可能是一个蓄意举动，旨在确保无法对水进行氰化物检测。

sentences.en: Lawyer Oto Hazabwan claimed to have seen a police file with a confession from Runga Saputra in which he admitted he was hired to kill Mina,
sentences.zh: 律师奥托·哈扎布万（Oto Hazabwan）声称曾看到一份警方文件，其中包含伦加·萨普特拉的供词，他承认自己受雇杀害薇娜，

sentences.en: but that this file had mysteriously disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但这份文件却神秘地消失了。

sentences.en: Taking the witness stand, Runga denied having gotten rid of the hot water that had been used to make Mina's iced coffee.
sentences.zh: 伦加走上证人席，否认自己曾倒掉用来冲泡薇娜冰咖啡的热水。

sentences.en: He then changed his mind and said he wasn't sure if he had.
sentences.zh: 随后他又改口称自己记不清是否倒掉了。

sentences.en: This inconsistency raised some eyebrows about his credibility, but when asked if he'd accepted any money from Mina's husband, Arif Simarco, to commit the murder,
sentences.zh: 这一前后矛盾的说法让人对他的可信度产生怀疑，但当被问及是否曾接受薇娜的丈夫阿里夫·西马尔科（Arif Simarco）的钱来实施谋杀时，

sentences.en: Runga vehemently denied it.
sentences.zh: 伦加坚决予以否认。

sentences.en: At the time of the trial, he was still employed at Olivier Café.
sentences.zh: 在审判期间，他仍然受雇于奥利弗咖啡馆。

sentences.en: If I received the money, I would have quit my job, he stated.
sentences.zh: 他宣称：“如果我拿了钱，我早就辞职了。”

sentences.en: The prosecution said it didn't matter if the hot water used to make the iced coffee had been disposed of.
sentences.zh: 控方表示，用来冲泡冰咖啡的热水是否被倒掉并不重要。

sentences.en: Experts testified that if the cyanide was put into hot water, the resulting steam would have
sentences.zh: 专家作证称，如果将氰化物放入热水中，产生的蒸汽会

sentences.en: given off a strong smell of burnt almonds, and in an enclosed space like the café, others who inhaled the steam would have also been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 散发出浓烈的烤杏仁气味，而在咖啡馆这样的密闭空间里，其他吸入蒸汽的人也会中毒。

sentences.en: Given that no one else was affected, and even Jessica claimed that the coffee had smelled normal, the cyanide had to have been put into the drink when it was already cold.
sentences.zh: 鉴于没有其他人受到影响，且连杰西卡都声称咖啡闻起来很正常，氰化物一定是在饮品已经变凉时才被放进去的。

sentences.en: And the only one who went anywhere near the drink when it was cold… was Jessica.
sentences.zh: 而在饮品变凉时唯一走近过它的人……就是杰西卡。

sentences.en: Arif Simarco also rejected the allegation that he'd conspired to have Mina killed, saying he'd never met Runga Seputra before in his life.
sentences.zh: 阿里夫·西马尔科也否认了自己曾合谋杀害薇娜的指控，称他生前从未见过伦加·塞普特拉（Runga Seputra）。

sentences.en: He testified about how angry Jessica had been at Mina for suggesting she break up with her boyfriend, and how this had led to Mina becoming
sentences.zh: 他作证称，杰西卡曾因薇娜建议她与男友分手而对其极为愤怒，这导致薇娜开始

sentences.en: afraid of Jessica's anger and not wanting to meet her alone.
sentences.zh: 害怕杰西卡的怒火，并不想单独与她见面。

sentences.en: Jessica's anger issues were further solidified by the comments she allegedly made to her former boss in Sydney, Christy Carter.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡的愤怒问题从她据称对悉尼前老板克里斯蒂·卡特（Christy Carter）说的话中得到了进一步证实。

sentences.en: While Christy didn't give evidence, her statement detailing Jessica's suicide attempts,
sentences.zh: 虽然克里斯蒂没有出庭作证，但法庭上宣读了她的证词，其中详细记录了杰西卡的自杀未遂事件、

sentences.en: her threats to kill Christy and her mother, and her comments that she knew the right dosage to kill someone were read to the court.
sentences.zh: 她扬言要杀害克里斯蒂及其母亲的威胁，以及她声称自己知道杀死某个特定剂量的言论。

sentences.en: These comments appeared to lend further weight to testimony provided by several psychologists, who described Jessica as being intelligent and confident with a narcissistic
sentences.zh: 这些言论似乎为几位心理学家的证词提供了更多分量。他们将杰西卡描述为一个既聪明自信又具有自恋

sentences.en: personality and a huge impulse to be at the centre of attention.
sentences.zh: 人格、且有着强烈渴望成为关注焦点的冲动的人。

sentences.en: One clinical psychologist who had interviewed Jessica shortly after her arrest said that she was calm in situations where she could
sentences.zh: 一位在杰西卡被捕后不久对其进行过面谈的临床心理学家表示，在能够

sentences.en: anticipate what was coming next, but it was when something unexpected happened that her emotions ignited.
sentences.zh: 预料到接下来会发生什么的情况下，她表现得很镇定，但每当发生意料之外的事情时，她的情绪就会被点燃。

sentences.en: Having studied the CCTV footage from Olivier Café, this psychologist believed that Jessica showed no signs of panic when Mina collapsed.
sentences.zh: 通过研究奥利弗咖啡馆的监控录像，这位心理学家认为，在薇娜倒下时，杰西卡没有表现出任何恐慌的迹象。

sentences.en: Even when Jessica walked over to fetch some water for Mina, she didn't hurry.
sentences.zh: 甚至当杰西卡走过去为薇娜取水时，她也没有表现得慌忙。

sentences.en: A criminologist from the University of Jakarta testified that he'd interviewed Jessica twice at the police station,
sentences.zh: 雅加达大学的一位犯罪学家作证称，他在警察局对杰西卡进行了两次面谈，

sentences.en: during which he'd used physiognomy, the practice of assessing a person's character based on their outer appearance.
sentences.zh: 在此期间他使用了相面术，这是一种根据外表来评估一个人性格的做法。

sentences.en: Studying Jessica's facial features and expressions while they spoke, he determined that she had a narcissistic personality and a great desire to be loved.
sentences.zh: 在他们交谈时观察杰西卡的面部特征和表情后，他断定她具有自恋人格，并且有着强烈的被爱渴望。

sentences.en: While he didn't find her to have psychopath traits, he did find her to be emotionally unstable, spiteful, and unable to tolerate criticism.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有发现她具有精神病态特征，但他确实发现她情绪不稳定、怀恨在心且无法容忍批评。

sentences.en: A criminologist for the defence team refuted that a criminologist has no place examining an individual's gestures without assistance from a psychologiSt. She told the judges,
sentences.zh: 辩护团队的一位犯罪学家反驳称，在没有心理学家协助的情况下，犯罪学家根本没有资格审查个人的手势。她对法官们说：

sentences.en: Physionomy is only used to describe potential offences or people who have the potential to commit a crime.
sentences.zh: “相面术只能用来描述潜在的罪行或具有犯罪潜质的人。”

sentences.en: It can't be used to determine whether someone is guilty.
sentences.zh: “它不能用来判定某人是否有罪。”

sentences.en: But the major argument for Jessica's innocence stemmed from the results of the toxicology testing, in which only small traces of cyanide were
sentences.zh: 但支持杰西卡无罪的主要论点源于毒理学检测结果，在美娜（Myrna）死后几天，在其胃部只

sentences.en: detected in Myrna's stomach several days after her death.
sentences.zh: 检测到了微量的氰化物。

sentences.en: The forensic pathologist who examined Myrna's body testified that her stomach and esophagus had turned black, which clearly indicated that she had been poisoned
sentences.zh: 检查美娜遗体的法医病理学家作证称，她的胃和食道已经变黑，这清楚地表明她曾遭到

sentences.en: using a very toxic substance.
sentences.zh: 剧毒物质的毒害。

sentences.en: A police toxicology expert told the court that after his expert team conducted a series of tests, he had no doubt that Myrna was killed by the cyanide.
sentences.zh: 一名警方毒理学专家对法庭表示，在其专家团队进行了一系列测试后，他毫不怀疑美娜是被氰化物杀害的。

sentences.en: But Dr Jaya Surya-Admaja, a forensic pathologist from the University of Indonesia, testified for the defence that these traces of cyanide
sentences.zh: 但印度尼西亚大学的法医病理学家贾亚·苏里亚-阿德马贾（Dr Jaya Surya-Admaja）博士为辩方出庭作证称，美娜胃中的这些

sentences.en: in Myrna's stomach had probably come from the embalming chemicals that were used to preserve her body,
sentences.zh: 微量氰化物很可能来自用于保存其遗体的防腐化学物质，

sentences.en: and that there was nothing to disprove that Myrna hadn't died from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 并且没有任何证据能反驳美娜并非死于自然原因。

sentences.en: If you don't check all the organs, you can't determine the cause of death, Dr Admaja stated to the court.
sentences.zh: 阿德马贾博士对法庭陈述：“如果你不检查所有器官，就无法确定死因。”

sentences.en: That's forensic's dogma.
sentences.zh: “这是法医学的教条。”

sentences.en: We wouldn't know whether Myrna had a stroke, for example, unless you examined her brain.
sentences.zh: “例如，除非检查她的大脑，否则我们无从得知美娜是否突发中风。”

sentences.en: Would the lungs be infected with certain diseases or not?
sentences.zh: “肺部是否感染了某些疾病？”

sentences.en: Not to mention the heart.
sentences.zh: 更不用说心脏了。

sentences.en: All of these are potential causes of death.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是潜在的死因。

sentences.en: Dr Admaja also said that one of the telltale signs of cyanide poisoning is a red discolouration of the skin.
sentences.zh: 阿德马贾博士还表示，氰化物中毒的明显标志之一是皮肤变红。

sentences.en: When Myrna was first brought into the morgue, he said her skin was blue.
sentences.zh: 他说，当美娜最初被送到停尸房时，她的皮肤是蓝色的。

sentences.en: However, once the news got out that she had died from cyanide poisoning, the photos circulated online and her skin was clearly red.
sentences.zh: 然而，一旦她死于氰化物中毒的消息传开，照片在网上流传，她的皮肤就明显变红了。

sentences.en: The red-tinged photos had been submitted to the court by Myrna's father earlier that day.
sentences.zh: 带有红色调的照片是美娜的父亲当天早些时候提交给法庭的。

sentences.en: According to Dr Admaja, those photos could have been easily altered, a claim that caused commotion in the courtroom and provoked Myrna's father to stand up in shock and voice
sentences.zh: 据阿德马贾博士称，这些照片很容易被篡改，这一说法在法庭上引发了一阵骚动，并激怒了美娜的父亲，使他震惊地站起身来

sentences.en: his outrage.
sentences.zh: 表达他的愤怒。

sentences.en: Two other forensic pathologists from Australia supported Dr Admaja's testimony that the
sentences.zh: 来自澳大利亚的其他两名法医病理学家支持阿德马贾博士的证词，即美娜胃中发现的

sentences.en: low levels of cyanide found in Myrna's stomach couldn't rule out the possibility that she had died from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 低水平氰化物不能排除她死于自然原因的可能性。
